summary: Fider is a self-hosted platform designed to gather, organise, and prioritise user feedback. It provides a centralised space where communities or customers can submit feature requests and vote on items.
goodFor: Teams and project maintainers who want an open-source alternative to proprietary feedback tools like UserVoice to run on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: Adoption depends entirely on getting your users to use a separate platform for feedback rather than your existing issue tracker or support channels.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage, set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination, and link a separate database instance.
